the authors have shown that in adolescents with KS, topical TRT did NOT suppress spermatogenesis, and that sperm cryopreservation should always be offered to all KS adolescents who have not yet fathered a child, regardless of whether or not they have started or are planning to start TRT.

we have shown that testosterone replacement in young males does not seem to have a negative effect on spermatogenesis and that sperm retrieval rates were similar to what has been reported in adult men with KS.

the combination of topical testosterone and an aromatase inhibitor appears to have no negative effects on spermatogenesis in Klinefelter adolescents and may be a reasonable treatment option in this population.
